Data.Name: initialText
Data.Data:
Attn: Chief of Engineering

Due to the recent widespread recall issued for defective P.A.C.M.A.N. generators shipped to Nanotrasen mining stations, this starship has been outfitted with a S.U.P.E.R.P.A.C.M.A.N uranium generator to ensure reliable power production for the duration of its mission.

Data.Data: The display reads: "Orbital lock engaged. Spaceflight mode unavailable."
